source_first_discovery.summary: Research examples distinguish invalid fuzz-driver calling contexts from application entry-point bugs; a later context validator establishes one narrow code-supported successful rejection while other agent judgements remain unreliable.
governance_properties: AI-generated fuzz drivers caused actual crashes using invalid internal function preconditions; a crash in the driver is not a justified inference of a reachable application vulnerability (E001).
Context-based validator checked concrete application call paths and rejected an infeasible crash after source-code analysis (E002).
The added validator itself produced errors; independent assurance cannot be assumed for its aggregate filter output (E003).

limitations: The authors' aggregate prose and Table 2 differ in totals; figures are attributed and not silently reconciled.
The reviewed benchmark is controlled. No specific maintainer response, production outage, loss or exploitation is proved.
The manually reviewed validator sample shows inaccurate analyses alongside the demonstrated positive verification example; E002 success is bounded and does not certify all rejects.
